draft.subject: Getting Maple Collective's first project set up
draft.body:
Hi Owen,

Following up on my welcome note from last week. Since Wrenfield is new for the team, the easiest starting point is a first project 
internally 
in fact, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so most things follow from there. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Nadia
